content: Swift Charts iOS 17+: .chartXSelection(value:) binding handles all gesture recognition for scrubbing; render RuleMark at selected x with negative zIndex plus .annotation(position:.top) popover for the lollipop. chartYSelection/chartAngleSelection also exist. iOS16 fallback: chartOverlay + GeometryReader + DragGesture with proxy.value(atX:). Sources: WWDC23 'Explore pie charts and interactivity', swiftwithmajid selection article.
